footerBlurb: Proctored skills assessments and hackathons that rank every candidate, for hiring teams, colleges and the people they assess.
newsletterBlurb: New hackathons, assessment features and hiring guides, about once a month.
confirmResubscribe: You unsubscribed earlier, so confirm with the link we just sent.
heroSr: Hire developers, design engineers, QA engineers and graduates on proven skills.
heroLead: CodeSpectra runs proctored, auto-scored skills assessments for software, CAD and mechanical design, QA and aptitude roles, and hands your team a ranked shortlist.
heroSlideBuildBody: Pick the role and experience band, then edit the difficulty-weighted questions.
heroSlideBuildAlt: Building an assessment for a design engineer role, with questions weighted by difficulty
heroSlideProctorBody: Webcam face matching, tab-switch and paste detection, each event timestamped.
heroSlideProctorAlt: A candidate taking a proctored coding test with webcam face matching and event logging
heroSlideRankBody: Everyone is scored the same way. Review the top 20, then release results or export.
heroSlideRankAlt: Ranked screening results with a top-20 shortlist cutoff
heroSlideJudgeBody: Teams submit repositories; judges score every entry on one rubric.
heroSlideJudgeAlt: Hackathon judge dashboard with team scores on a shared rubric
learnSectionTitle: Free explainers for every coding skill
learnSectionLead: Algorithms, system design, patterns and engineering practices, with code you can run and problems to practise.
bentoAnyRoleTitle: Assess any role, not only developers
bentoAnyRoleBody: Coding with hidden test cases, CAD design tasks, test-automation scripts, written answers and aptitude, in one assessment and one score.
bentoAltCode: Code brackets filled with streaming binary digits
bentoProctorBody: Every event is timestamped on the candidate’s report, so a reviewer decides what it means.
bentoWeightedLabel: Easy 3 points, medium 4 points, hard 5 points
bentoCadBody: Model a valve or pump part, then review drawings.
bentoAltCad: CAD model of a valve with a turning handwheel
bentoShortlistTitle: A ranked shortlist, not a pile of PDFs
bentoShortlistBody: Everyone is scored the same way. Review the top 20 of 100 and skip the rest.
bentoPlagiarismBody: Code answers are compared across everyone who took the test.
bentoReleaseBody: Publish scores to candidates, or download the results as CSV.
bentoHackathonTitle: Run hackathons on the same platform
bentoHackathonBody: Teams of up to five join with one link and submit a repository. Judges score every entry out of 100 on one rubric.
bentoAltTeam: A team of five submits a repository that judges score out of 100
bentoBankBody: Start from a generated set, then change any question before it goes out.
nfBody: The link may be old or mistyped. If you were opening an assessment, interview or certificate, use the link in your latest email.
nfDocsHint: Set up assessments, proctoring and the API
evSignInRemindersBody: We email you 48 hours before registration closes.
evReminderSet: We’ll remind you 48 hours before registration closes
evNoMatchBody: Try fewer filters, or turn on “Notify me” and we’ll tell you when a matching event is announced.
evNoneBody: New hackathons and contests appear here as soon as they’re announced. Turn on “Notify me” to hear first.
evSourcesNote: Listings come from organisers’ public feeds and official APIs and link to the organiser to register. Dates are shown in your time zone.
notifyEventsBody: Get new hackathons and coding events by email (weekly) or WhatsApp (as they’re announced, or once a week).
notifyNewsBody: One short digest a day by email or WhatsApp, only on days with news. Opt in, stop any time.
notifyBlogBody: One email a week with the new explainers on Learn. No spam.
notifyConsent: I agree to receive CodeSpectra updates on WhatsApp for the topics I picked. I can reply STOP at any time to stop.
notifyWeekly: Once a week: hackathons this week
notifyCountry: In-person events in (country code, e.g. IN, US)
notifyErrConsent: Tick the box to agree to WhatsApp messages.
notifyCheckInbox: Check your inbox and click the confirmation link. It works for 72 hours.
notifyWaYes: To turn on WhatsApp, reply {yes} to our message
notifyFinePrintWa: We’ll ask you to confirm first. Every message has an unsubscribe link; on WhatsApp reply STOP.
notifyFinePrint: We’ll ask you to confirm first. Every email has an unsubscribe link.
cartHint: Items you add show up here.
cartEmptyBody: Browse books, courses, mentoring and more.
cartNote: Final tax, shipping and discounts are confirmed at checkout.
cartIssueUnavailable: No longer available — remove it to continue.
cartIssueOutOfStock: Sold out — remove it or save it for later.
cartIssueQtyReduced: Fewer units left — quantity will be reduced.
cartIssueSlotUnavailable: This time was taken — remove it and pick another slot.
cartIssueSlotMissing: Pick a time on the item page.
offlineDescription: Questions you saved on this device. Answers are sent and graded when you are back online.
offlineBanner: You are offline. Pages that need your account will open again when the connection is back.
offlineUnsupported: Offline practice is not available in this browser
offlineUnsupportedBody: Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
offlineEmptyBody: On your dashboard, tap Save for offline on the daily challenge. It will be here even without a connection.
offlineSavedForLater: Saved. It will be sent and graded when you are back online.
offlineDraftSaved: Your draft is saved on this device as you type.
offlineTestsOnServer: Tests run on our servers, so results appear once your answer is sent.
offlineRetry: Will retry when the connection is back
offlineSignIn: Sign in to send this answer
offlineErrQueueFull: Too many answers waiting to sync. Go online to send them first.
notifyDigestBody: Today’s best hackathons, contests and tech news, once a day by email or WhatsApp. Opt in, stop any time.
askBody: Search the daily digests, tech news, the events board and Learn. Answers link to the pages they come from.
askPlaceholder: Which hackathons are open this week?
askTooShort: Type a question of at least two characters.
askCaptcha: Please complete the verification, then ask again.
askError: Could not get an answer. Try again.
askAiNote: AI answer from the linked pages. Check the source before you register.
askNoResults: Nothing found. Try other words, or browse the digest and the events board.
askFallback:ai_off: AI answers are off right now, so here are the search results.
askFallback:daily_cap: Today’s AI answers are used up, so here are the search results.
askFallback:budget: AI answers are paused, so here are the search results.
askFallback:flagged: Here are the search results for your question.
askFallback:ai_failed: The AI answer didn’t work this time, so here are the search results.
rsAssessed: {applicants} applicants assessed. Top {top} shortlisted for interview.
rsCaption: Sample ranked results for {title}. Candidates ranked 1 to {top} are shortlisted.
rsFootnote: Illustrative data. Names are invented. Points are difficulty-weighted: easy 3, medium 4, hard 5.
mktNoTimes: No free times in these two weeks — try the next ones.
mktBoughtThis: Bought this? {signIn} to leave a review.
mktReviewPh: What did you like? What could be better?
